scope: XMemGetWriteWatch ordinal 17, default/unpaused mode only. It forwards to host GetWriteWatch; the console suspend option and pause/resume behavior are not implemented.
native_method: Runs the hash-pinned console thunk in a temporary mapped PE, replacing its imported GetWriteWatch with a native six-argument stub. The stub checks forwarded values and writes output; the harness also flips the pause-state global to confirm the unimplemented paused return.
guest_checks: Reserve and commit four Windows write-watch pages, write two and compare the XMem query against the host GetWriteWatch result and surrounding guards.
Reset through XMemGetWriteWatch, modify a different page, check the new result and compare invalid flag behavior with the host. Verify name and ordinal 17 identity.
limits: XMemSetOption and write-watch suspension are not supported; the provider always uses the default unpaused behavior.
The control allocates pages through desktop VirtualAlloc. The existing XMemVirtualAlloc implementation does not yet support the write-watch allocation profile.
No complete console DLL success-path or GPU behavior is claimed.
